text:
ashley wong: Hi team! I'm Ashley, joining Platform Integrations today (IC2). Super excited :) Quick checklist from my side so I don't slow anyone down:
- Do we have a standard MDM profile for Intel + M1? I'm getting a new Mac but not sure which yet.
- Who handles an extra monitor request? I work evenings (PST) so want to make sure ergonomics are sorted.
- Can someone add me to redwood-internal org in Console (read) and to #eng so I can follow team convos.
- Also throwing a fun fact: I bake terrible sourdough but am training my starter. :bread:

sam (people ops): Welcome Ashley!! :tada:
- MDM: Enroll at https://mdm.redwood.example/enroll and choose the matching image when you pick your device ("Company Mac - Intel" or "Company Mac - Apple Silicon"). If IT hasn't shipped yet tell me and I'll prioritize.
- Monitor / equipment: fill this short form: https://forms.redwood.example/equipment with "evening shift" in the notes. Ops approves same-day for ergonomic requests.
- Console: confirm the org slug you need (looks like "redwood-internal"), I'll file the IAM ticket. I'll also assign you a buddy — looping in Marcos.

marcos (devex): Hey Ashley 1 hi! I'm your buddy. Quick tips:
- Add SSH key: https://id.redwood.example/account/ssh-keys
- Add SSO secondary email for recovery in case of password resets.
- If you plan to run local model dev work, ask for the "dev-gpu-allow" tag on your account.
- For a quick setup call, I'm free 90 minutes after standup today.

zoe (security): Added a note: please enable 2FA on your SSO (we enforce it), and if you get a device from the vendor, register the serial on the equipment form. We'll need that for asset tracking.

mdm-bot: Enrollment request received for ashley.wong@example.com. Device: unknown. Status: awaiting selection (user to pick device type).

ashley wong: Thanks all 1 picking "Intel" for now (I had to switch from personal Silicon laptop). Filled the equipment form and put "standing desk + monitor" in the notes. Sent DM to @sam with shipping address for sticker pack.

marcos (devex): Great — once you're on VPN ping me and we can test console access. Also small heads-up: some internal repos require you to join the "integrations" GitHub team; you'll get an invite after IAM ticket completes.

sam (people ops): Stickers + welcome pack confirmed. Buddy lunch voucher code sent. Welcome to Redwood!! :confetti_ball:

ashley wong: Woo! Thanks everyone. Fun fact follow-up: if anyone wants my sourdough disaster pics later, I'll post them in #random. :)
